question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

OML−HFE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d86ab43ab183be07294082b10d2fca32d695cd3515ef3a7797894c4ebe07d3b.png]

ock.com/tb/4cc7b1764eff7bcc204227289d5e774620886d097a93820d13a6ede5dbd17d81.png]
